pieces.file: Mixture of Experts — rich — who gets called.png
pieces.title: Who gets called
pieces.caption: Every page's avatar, sized by how many other pages link to it. Ten pages take a fifth of all the typed links. Eighteen have no typed link pointing at them. *What is real and what is a choice:* Typed links stand in for 'being called'; the map's use counts would be closer. This is the shape the page warns of, not yet the thing: its 'collapse' is one or two experts doing all the work, and the top two here take about 6 percent. *Leaking in:* Weave Ceremony, which defines hubs as the top inbound decile.

verdicts.file: Mixture of Experts — rich — who gets called.png
verdicts.why: The counts are right but "never called at all" (caption and in-image line) is false as worded: the eighteen have no typed link from another map page, and the list includes Return Ceremony and The Palace Voice, which CHILD.md calls every session; Palace Map itself says "what everyone holds, no one needs to cite". Change both lines to "eighteen have no typed link pointing at them". The mosaic itself is good and the title can stay.
